name: sales-1to1-short
note:
The SAME 11-point sales 1:1 agenda as sales-1to1, against a call that barely started — a dozen sentences, about 90 seconds, reported by a colleague on 2026-10-12 as scoring 9 of 11 covered. It is the precision fixture: sales-1to1 catches a judge that marks nothing, this one catches a judge that marks everything. A thin call is the normal case for the live panel (every call is thin for its first two minutes), so a judge that cannot be thin here is wrong for most of every meeting.

`expected` is a hand label read off the transcript below, counting only what was actually said: 3 covered, 5 touched, 3 open. The debatable ones, stated so a later reader can disagree with the label rather than with the measurement: a2 is open because a pipeline number down from last week is not sales results against a target (no target and no results are ever mentioned); a6 is touched because "the three deals closest to closing" names no deal and "push for decisions" is not an expectation that they close; a7 is touched because a deal that slipped is an outcome, not a stated blocker.
